name: Perenolde Tiara
summary: In the ruins of Alterac, the Perenolde Tiara has surfaced again. Dwarven craftsmen of Ironforge made the emerald-studded heirloom, and collectors in Stormwind seek it.

sections.title: A Relic of a Ruined Kingdom
sections.body: The Perenolde family ruled Alterac until the kingdom fell during the Second War. Among their treasures was a delicate tiara, made by master jewelers in Ironforge and set with brilliant emeralds. After King Aiden Perenolde’s treachery brought Alterac to ruin, the tiara vanished amid the devastation of the high crags.

sections.title: The Miser's Prize
sections.body: Grel'borg the Miser, an ogre mage, unearthed the tiara while searching Alterac’s ruins for abandoned wealth. Word of the relic reached Count Remington Ridgewell, a wealthy noble in Stormwind who collects famous relics for his family museum. Now the count seeks to take the tiara from the ogre.

faq.answer: The Perenolde Tiara is an heirloom of Alterac’s royal Perenolde family. Dwarven jewelers in Ironforge crafted it and set it with emeralds before it was lost in the kingdom’s downfall.
Grel'borg the Miser, an ogre mage, found the tiara among Alterac’s snowbound ruins. He guards it while searching the ruined kingdom for more treasure.

faq.q: Why does Count Remington Ridgewell want it?
faq.answer: Count Remington Ridgewell collects historic and prestigious antiquities for his family museum in Stormwind. He wants the tiara as a crown jewel from a fallen human kingdom.
The Perenoldes ruled the kingdom of Alterac. During the Second War, King Aiden Perenolde betrayed the Alliance to the Orcish Horde, and his realm fell into ruin.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can see Ironforge’s gemcraft in the emeralds its master jewelers cut and set for the human royalty of the north.
As an Alliance member, you face a bitter reminder of House Perenolde, whose betrayal during the Second War nearly destroyed the original Alliance of Lordaeron.
